summary: A one coach practice appears to lose bookings to a free builder address, a leftover placeholder email and a name that changes from line to line, just before Black Friday on 27 November.

findings.problem: The contact area appears to show info@mysite.com, the template placeholder, next to your real address, and the site runs on a free Wix address with the Wix advert at the top.
findings.cost: A client who writes to the placeholder never reaches you, and a free address with an advert signals a hobby, so buyers hesitate before paying for sessions.
findings.fix: Remove the placeholder, your own domain, no builder advert.

findings.problem: The name changes across the page: Life Coaching by Eric, Life Coaching Co and The Life Coaching CO, and the text talks about an experienced coaching team.
findings.cost: A visitor cannot tell who they are hiring or whether it is one person or a company, and unclear trust costs the first booking.
findings.fix: One brand name and one clear story about you.

findings.problem: Sessions are listed one by one at 50 to 80 dollars with a free discovery call, and I could not find a package, an offer page or a way to capture an email for a promotion.
findings.cost: On Black Friday people buy bundles and deals, and a coach with only single sessions has nothing to promote and no list to send it to.
findings.fix: A Black Friday coaching package page with email capture.

redesign: Own domain, one brand, no placeholder.
Black Friday package page with a countdown.
Email capture and booking in one flow.
